from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Synthesis & Summary", [
            "Visual anchoring, sequence, and balanced precision.",
            "Explain concepts simply, like to a child.",
            "Transform chaotic numbers into a clear path."
        ])
        
        # Elements
        criteria = VGroup(
            Text("Visual Anchoring", font_size=24),
            Text("Logical Sequence", font_size=24),
            Text("Balanced Precision", font_size=24)
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.4)
        
        # Issue 33: Reposition criteria to B5
        self.place_at_grid(criteria, 'B5', scale_factor=0.7)
        
        # Issue 32: Separate ring and mastery text
        ring = Circle(radius=0.8, color="#FFFF00")
        self.place_at_grid(ring, 'C4', scale_factor=1.2)
        
        # Issue 34: Move mastery text lower
        mastery = Text("Mastery", font_size=32, color="#FF00FF")
        self.place_at_grid(mastery, 'E4', scale_factor=0.8)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(criteria), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#00FFFF"), run_time=0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(Create(ring), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#00FF00"), run_time=0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(Write(mastery), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#FFD700"), run_time=0.5)
        
        self.wait(2)

sections.title: Introduction: The 'Bridge' Analogy (0:00-0:45)
sections.content: Define an effective explanation not as a recitation of facts, but as a bridge between the student's current mental model and the target concept. Emphasize the goal: cognitive clarity.
sections.example: An animation showing a student stranded on a 'Confusion Island' needing a bridge to reach the 'Mastery Mainland'.

sections.title: Criterion 1: Visual-Conceptual Coupling (0:45-1:45)
sections.content: Effective math must anchor abstract symbols to visual representations. Prerequisite: Understanding that graphs are geometric maps of algebraic laws.
sections.example: Visualizing the derivative: Instead of just showing f'(x), animate a tangent line moving along a parabola (The 'Rollercoaster Curve') to show slope change.

sections.title: Criterion 2: Logical Scaffolding & Sequence (1:45-3:00)
sections.content: Concepts must be presented in a 'low-friction' order. Introduce prerequisites (e.g., properties of functions) before discussing optimization. Break complexity into digestible, logical chunks.
sections.example: A 'Building Block' animation: A robot stacking cubes labeled 'Variables', 'Operators', and 'Logic' to form a stable structure rather than throwing all at once.

sections.title: Criterion 3: Precision vs. Accessibility (3:00-4:00)
sections.content: Explain the balance between rigorous terminology and intuitive language. Avoid 'jargon-stuffing' by using relatable analogies before formalizing with proofs.
sections.example: Comparing a 'Formal Math Definition' (a dense cloud of text) with a 'Functional Analogy' (explaining an algorithm as a 'Recipe for a Cooking Robot').

sections.title: Synthesis & Summary (4:00-5:00)
sections.content: Recap the three pillars: Visual Anchoring, Logical Sequence, and Balanced Precision. Challenge the learner to explain a concept to a '5-year-old animal avatar'.
sections.example: A final animation: A squirrel trying to solve a puzzle using the three pillars, transforming a 'chaotic forest' of numbers into a 'clear path' to the finish line.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: Labels 'Confusion' and 'Mastery' are positioned too close to the vertical center, risking proximity collision with the 'Logical Bridge' text. Fix: Line 58: self.place_at_grid('confusion', 'B1', scale_factor=0.8); Line 62: self.place_at_grid('mastery', 'B6', scale_factor=0.8) (line=58, object=confusion and mastery labels)
issues.resolution_note: Adjusted labels and square placements to B1 and B6.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: The 'Logical Bridge' element is visually cramped between the two nodes, creating a cluttered central alignment. Fix: Line 60: self.place_at_grid('logical_bridge', 'A3', scale_factor=0.9) (line=60, object=Logical Bridge text)
issues.resolution_note: Positioned 'Logical Bridge' text at A3.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: The bridge connection line is too short, leading to potential overlapping of the bridge element with the confusion/mastery labels. Fix: Line 65: self.place_in_area('bridge_line', 'B2', 'B5', scale_factor=1.0) (line=65, object=bridge_line)
issues.resolution_note: Placed bridge_line in area B2-B5.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_2] Problem: Input label and container are too close to the left-aligned lecture text, creating visual clutter. Fix: Line 58: self.place_at_grid(input_group, 'B3', scale_factor=0.8) (line=58, object=input_group)
issues.resolution_note: Adjusted positioning to B3 (scale 0.8) to reduce clutter with lecture text.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_2] Problem: Visual Output label is positioned too far right, causing unbalanced whitespace. Fix: Line 69: self.place_at_grid(output_text, 'B4', scale_factor=0.8) (line=69, object=output_text)
issues.resolution_note: Moved output display to B4 (scale 0.8) to improve balance.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_2] Problem: Potential obstruction of the vertical center axis if animation grows. Fix: Line 60: self.place_in_area(animation_box, 'A3', 'C5', scale_factor=0.7) (line=60, object=animation_container)
issues.resolution_note: Ensured layout avoids central obstruction by grouping components efficiently.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_3] Problem: Vertical stacking at the bottom creates a 'bottom-heavy' layout that ignores the unused upper grid space and creates visual clutter. Fix: Line 64, 66, 68: Re-center the stack vertically to balance the screen. Change positions to: boxes[0] at C3, boxes[1] at D3, boxes[2] at E3. (line=64, object=boxes)
issues.resolution_note: Adjusted box positions to C4, D4, E4 for better vertical balance.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_3] Problem: Labels within the box elements are cramped, potentially leading to clipping or readability issues. Fix: Apply a uniform scale_factor=0.75 to all box elements to maintain clear padding within the grid cells. (line=64, object=boxes)
issues.resolution_note: Applied scale_factor=0.75 to the VGroup of boxes to fix readability.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_3] Problem: Potential visual tension between the left-side lecture notes and the right-side elements due to tight horizontal proximity. Fix: Shift the entire column stack from column 3 to column 4 to increase whitespace between the text and the animation. Change positions to: boxes[0] at C4, boxes[1] at D4, boxes[2] at E4. (line=64, object=boxes)
issues.resolution_note: Shifted column stack from grid 3 to 4 to improve horizontal spacing.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_4] Problem: Labels 'Formal Definition' and 'Cooking Recipe' overlap with their respective bounding boxes and lack hierarchical visual separation. Fix: Line 68: self.place_at_grid(formal_math, 'B2', scale_factor=0.7); self.add_label(formal_math, 'Formal Definition', position='top', offset=0.2) (line=68, object=formal_math)
issues.resolution_note: Added label and adjusted placement as per critic suggestion.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_4] Problem: The equals sign '=' at B4 is poorly aligned between the two concepts, creating a cluttered visual flow in the center of the grid. Fix: Line 78: self.place_at_grid(eq, 'B3', scale_factor=0.6) (line=78, object=eq)
issues.resolution_note: Moved equality sign to B3 for better visual flow.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_4] Problem: The functional_analogy (Cooking Recipe) object occupies grid position B5, which is too crowded relative to the other elements. Fix: Line 73: self.place_at_grid(functional_analogy, 'B4', scale_factor=0.7); self.add_label(functional_analogy, 'Cooking Recipe', position='top', offset=0.2) (line=73, object=functional_analogy)
issues.resolution_note: Moved functional analogy to B4 and added label.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_5] Problem: The yellow ring and the label 'Mastery' currently share grid coordinate C4, causing significant overlap and visual clutter. Fix: Line 62: self.place_at_grid(ring, 'C4', scale_factor=1.2); Line 65: self.place_at_grid(mastery, 'D4', scale_factor=0.8) (line=62, object=ring and mastery)
issues.resolution_note: Resolved by separating ring and mastery text coordinates and scaling them appropriately based on feedback. Ring now at C4, mastery text now at E4.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_5] Problem: The criteria object at B2 is positioned too close to the main body text, potentially causing visual distraction. Fix: Line 59: self.place_at_grid(criteria, 'B5', scale_factor=0.7) (line=59, object=criteria)
